```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(hemispheR)# For binarization and estimating canopy measures
library(dplyr)

set up directories and read the mask
```{r}
base_dir <- "./canopy_photos"

dir.create(file.path(base_dir,"selected_images"), showWarnings=FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(base_dir,"binarized"), showWarnings=FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(base_dir,"metrics"), showWarnings=FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(base_dir,"review_panels"), showWarnings=FALSE)

mask <- file.path(base_dir,"mask","HemiPhotoMask.svg")

image_mask <- image_read(mask) |>
  image_transparent("white") |>
  image_convert("png")
```

 convert 360 to hemisphere and mask (if required)
```{r}
source("./_functions/process_360_image.R")

files_360 <- list.files(
  "./canopy_photos/raw_360",
  pattern = "\\.(jpg|jpeg|png|dng|svg)$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)
#selected_files_360 <-
future_lapply(
    files_360,
    process_360_image,
    output_dir = "./canopy_photos/converted_360",

```

resize and mask hemisphere photos
```{r}
source("./_functions/process_hemi_image.R")
files_hemi <- list.files(
  "./canopy_photos/raw_hemi",
  pattern = "\\.(jpg|jpeg|png|dng|svg)$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)
image_mask <- image_read(
  "./canopy_photos/mask/hemisphere_mask_3000.png"
)
plan(multisession, workers = 4)
#selected_files_hemi <-
tic()
  future_lapply(
  files_hemi,
  process_hemi_image,
  output_dir = "./canopy_photos/standardized_hemi",
  image_mask = image_mask,
  future.seed = TRUE
)
  toc()#460secs
```

generate canopy metrics and compare to help select best image settings
```{r}
source("./_functions/binarize_image.R")

options <- expand.grid(
  channel = c("2BG"),
  gamma = c(1.0, 1.3, 1.6, 1.9),
  stretch = c(FALSE),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


selected_images <- list.files(
  file.path(base_dir,"standardized_hemi"),
  full.names=TRUE
)

# selected_images <- selected_images[
#   seq(1, length(selected_images), by = 20)
# ]

process_image <- function(img, options) {

  cat("Processing", basename(img), "\n")

  results <- vector("list", nrow(options))

  for(i in seq_len(nrow(options))) {

    opt <- options[i, ]

    result <- binarize_image(
      image_file = img,
      method     = "Otsu",
      channel    = opt$channel,
      gamma      = opt$gamma,
      stretch    = opt$stretch
    )

    gapfrac <- gapfrac_fisheye(
      result$binary,
      maxVZA = 90,
      lens = "equidistant",
      endVZA = 70,
      display = FALSE,
      message = FALSE
    )

    canopy <- canopy_fisheye(gapfrac)

    results[[i]] <- canopy |>
      mutate(
        Image = result$image,
        Method = "Otsu",
        Channel = opt$channel,
        Gamma = opt$gamma,
        Stretch = opt$stretch,
        OptionID = i
      )

  }

  bind_rows(results)

}

tic()

all_metrics <- future_lapply(
  selected_images,
  process_image,
  options = options,
  future.seed = TRUE
)

toc()

metric_table <- bind_rows(all_metrics)


fwrite(
  metric_table,
  file.path(
    base_dir,
    "metrics",
    "otsu_option_comparison.csv"
  )
)
```

Create final binarized files and calculate metrics
```{r}

source("./_functions/binarize_image.R")

options <- expand.grid(
  channel = c("2BG"),
  gamma = c(1.6),
  stretch = c(FALSE),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


selected_images <- list.files(
  file.path(base_dir,"standardized_hemi"),
  full.names=TRUE
)

# selected_images <- selected_images[
#   seq(1, length(selected_images), by = 20)
# ]

process_image <- function(img, options) {

  cat("Processing", basename(img), "\n")

  results <- vector("list", nrow(options))

  for(i in seq_len(nrow(options))) {

    opt <- options[i, ]

    result <- binarize_image(
      image_file = img,
      method     = "Otsu",
      channel    = opt$channel,
      gamma      = opt$gamma,
      stretch    = opt$stretch
    )

    gapfrac <- gapfrac_fisheye(
      result$binary,
      maxVZA = 90,
      lens = "equidistant",
      endVZA = 70,
      display = FALSE,
      message = FALSE
    )

    canopy <- canopy_fisheye(gapfrac)

    results[[i]] <- canopy |>
      mutate(
        Image = result$image,
        Method = "Otsu",
        Channel = opt$channel,
        Gamma = opt$gamma,
        Stretch = opt$stretch,
        OptionID = i
      )

  }

  bind_rows(results)

}

tic()

all_metrics <- future_lapply(
  selected_images,
  process_image,
  options = options,
  future.seed = TRUE
)

toc()

metric_table <- bind_rows(all_metrics)


fwrite(
  metric_table,
  file.path(
    base_dir,
    "canopy_metrics_final",
    "canopy_light_data.csv"
  )
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

metric_table$plot_id <- sapply(
  strsplit(metric_table$id, "_"),
  \(x) paste(x[1:2], collapse = "_")
)
ggplot(
  metric_table,
  aes(
    x = plot_id,
    y = DIFN
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1
    )
  ) +
  ylab("DIFN") +
  xlab("Plot ID")
